confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are the most reliable. Accommodation is less certain and July is Phuket's low season, so rates may run below peak-season levels. Cocktail and wine_glass are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. FX provenance is limited: the 0.7002 observation was taken from a search-result summary of the RBA homepage (as at 4pm 14 October 2026) and was not verified against the F11 daily table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Thailand's other beach and island tourism centres (Krabi, Koh Samui, Pattaya) and tourist districts of Bangkok, adjusted for Phuket's low-season July accommodation pricing.
